newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian shares close below the highs.
newsitem.headline: Italian shares close below the highs.

text.p: Italian shares closed below record highs on Monday, as European bond markets came off the boil, after a stellar performance in which banks did much of the running.

The all-share Mibtel index closed 0.36 percent higher at 14,068 down from an all-time high of 14,175 reached earlier in the day. The blue Mib30 finished 0.12 percent higher at 21,406 after peaking at 21,608.
The Fib30 September index futures contract powered ahead, ending the day 0.73 percent higher at 21,630.

Banks were again at the centre of attention as investors snapped up shares in anticipation of a wave of restructuring in the industry as it gears up for increased competition from leaner foreign rivals.
Ambroveneto soared 9.75 percent, with trading halted twice as it tested a 10 percent limit on daily price movements, to close at 7,361 lire.

Banca di Roma, which announced at the weekend it had struck a deal with its managerial staff on reducing labour costs, shot up 7.89 percent to 1,450 lire. The bank had been left standing in recent days as other stocks made rapid gains.

Insurer Generali finished only 0.12 percent up qat 32,983 lire as investors continued to cold shoulder the stock. Most other insurers made modest gains although Alleanza was well bought, finishing 2.45 percent higher at 14,910 lire.
